temporaryPreparationScript:
import difflib
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
scratch = Path((root / 'tmp/profile-guard-scratch').read_text().strip())
relative = Path('modules/app-engine/src/test/java/io/justsearch/app/engine/EngineTestHarness.java')
source = (root / relative).read_text()
modified = source.replace('      System.setProperty("justsearch.data.dir", dataDir.toAbsolutePath().toString());\n', '').replace('      System.setProperty("user.home", dataDir.resolve("home").toAbsolutePath().toString());\n', '')
assert source != modified and source.count('      System.setProperty("justsearch.data.dir", dataDir.toAbsolutePath().toString());\n') == 1
assert (scratch / 'g3-fake-home/.justsearch/watched_roots.json').read_bytes() == (scratch / 'g3-sentinel-before.bin').read_bytes()
profile = scratch / 'g3/modules/app-engine/build/test-profile/test'
if profile.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(profile)
(scratch / 'g3' / relative).write_text(modified)
(scratch / 'g3-harness-reversion.patch').write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(source.splitlines(True), modified.splitlines(True), fromfile='a/' + str(relative), tofile='b/' + str(relative))))
print('Final G3: task profile cleared; sentinel unchanged; only two #885 setters removed in disposable clone.')
